intro.text: The oldest generation of kandra, who raised the Second Generation and then stepped back from the day-to-day rule of the kandra.
The first kandra, all Feruchemists, who were once Rashek's friends, Alendi's ten packmen. They raised the next generation of kandra, then left most of the ruling to it.

items.text: The Firsts set down their promises to the Lord Ruler as the first kandra laws, then took them to him for his approval.
At his trial, TenSoon speaks over KanPaar to address the First Generation, telling them how things stand in the world and warning that they may need to call for the Resolution.
TenSoon tells Sazed what became of Rashek's fellow packmen: they were turned into mistwraiths and then into kandra, and they are the First Generation.
When Sazed comes to the Homeland, the First Generation appear, send every other kandra away and speak with him alone, calling him a Worldbringer.
The Firsts go through Sazed's notes with him, hunting for Ruin's changes, and Haddek teaches him about Ruin and Preservation and the kandra's true god.

Haddek explains the Resolution to Sazed: on the First Generation's order, every kandra must remove their Blessings. Just then KanPaar arrives with followers to depose the Firsts, and they are imprisoned.
TenSoon breaks Sazed and the First Generation out of their prison.
Once the Firsts have recovered, the other kandra begin to tremble, and Haddek cries out that the Resolution has come.
